gaps.sentence: In no way ___ this report reflect the views of the editor.
gaps.explanation: In no way does this reflect… — formal disclaimer structure.

gaps.sentence: ___ the committee reach a decision, we cannot proceed.
gaps.explanation: Fronting 'Until…' emphasises the condition blocking progress.

gaps.sentence: Among the guests ___ the ambassador and her staff.
gaps.hint: fronted 'among' — verb agrees with later subject
gaps.explanation: Among the guests were the ambassador and her staff — verb before subject.

gaps.sentence: Little did the suspects ___ that the police were listening.
gaps.explanation: 'Little did they know' — 'know' as bare verb after the inverted auxiliary 'did'.

gaps.sentence: Only when the last guest had left ___ she sit down.
gaps.explanation: 'Only when … had left did she sit down' — inverted past simple.

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only when the audit was complete ___ the accounts released.
gaps.explanation: Only when X happened were the accounts released — inversion after only when.

gaps.sentence: Not until every passenger had been evacuated ___ the captain leave the ship.
gaps.explanation: 'Not until … did the captain leave …' — inverted past simple.
